Definition: probably from the base of G2767 (through the idea of mixing clay and water); earthenware, i.e. a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning):--tiling.
BiblicalUsage: Keramos means earthenware, tiling. Luke 5:19 says the friends let the paralysed man down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the roof was no barrier to faith: they broke through the tiling because they knew Jesus could heal.
